job.description: Low log volume per site (store_id), to spot a site that stops reporting.

detectors.detector_description: Unusually low log count for each site

ui_path: Observability > Machine learning > Anomaly detection > Jobs > Create job > data view 'App logs (workshop)' > Multi-metric. Metric Count, split field store_id.keyword, influencers store_id.keyword, tenant_name.keyword, app_code.keyword, bucket span 15m (low_count is set in the Advanced wizard). Job ID mlws-logs-store-volume, group mlws.
teaches: low_count models zero-count buckets, so a silent site is detected. A3 silences flagship site S-0117 for 120 minutes. Because S-0117 has about 4x normal volume, its drop is large relative to its own baseline.
